issues.summary: Position-unit mismatch bug discovered during third-pass self-review (2026-07-30). _entity_brief in both vibe/contracts.py and vibe/simulator_session.py returned e.x.raw / e.y.raw (fixed-point raw int, e.g. 5120 for world position 5.0), but every spatial consumer (regions in mission_engine, tactical distance checks, viewer) compared positions against world-unit floats (region r=3.0, retreat_range=3.0, etc.). This made escort_vip and capture_region objectives impossible to satisfy (raw 5120 vs world 5.0 never matches a world-unit region) and silently inflated all tactical distances by 1024x. The P4D self-test added escort_vip/capture_region cases that exposed this — prior passes never exercised those objective kinds despite M5 declaring them implemented. Fixed by returning e.x.to_float() / e.y.to_float() in both _entity_brief copies; health/shields/energy stay as raw int (P4A asserts marine_hp=46080=45*1024). Also fixed mission_engine._evaluate_objective(escort_vip) which used vip.x.raw directly, and mission_wave._make_attack_trigger which used u.x.raw for region containment check.
evidence: src/projects/cmre-porting/vibe/contracts.py (_entity_brief: x=e.x.to_float(), y=e.y.to_float(); docstring records the position contract)

artifacts/galaxy-vibe/p1-p9-regression/regression-20260730T072306Z.json (P4D checks escort_vip_success=true, escort_vip_failed_when_killed=true, capture_region_success=true, capture_region_blocked_by_enemy=true; P4C retreat_low_hp_moves_away=true with hp=20/45 dist world-units)
issues.nextAction: Closed. Position contract is now documented in _entity_brief docstring; future spatial code must use world-unit floats from _entity_brief, not raw ints.

issues.summary: M10 (shared_contracts_registry dynamic detection) was declared pending in the second-pass result.json. The static registry over-claimed SnapshotHandle and CatalogPatch as multi-consumer (extraction_eligible would have been true), but no consumer source other than mod_dev actually references those type names — other consumers use them indirectly via SimulatorSession.snapshot_create (returns dict) or scenario fields. Third pass (2026-07-30) added detect_contract_usage_dynamically() which scans each consumer module's source (via inspect.getsource on anchor symbols) for contract identifier references, and registry_with_dynamic_check() which cross-checks the static registry against the dynamic detection. The static registry was corrected: SnapshotHandle and CatalogPatch are now declared mod_dev-only with extraction_eligible=False. The p8_selftest adds two M10 checks: (a) m10_dynamic_contract_detection — core contracts must have declared == detected; (b) m10_dynamic_detection_responds_to_change — breaking the ally_ai anchor must remove ally_ai from the detected set, proving detection is live (not cached).
evidence: artifacts/galaxy-vibe/p1-p9-regression/regression-20260730T072306Z.json (P8 passed=true; details: m10_dynamic_contract_detection core_mismatches=[], m10_dynamic_detection_responds_to_change after_breaking_ally_ai_anchor Observation.detected=['tactical'])
issues.nextAction: Closed. Future contract additions to the registry must keep declared consumers_using consistent with detect_contract_usage_dynamically(); the p8_selftest cross-check enforces this.
